meta: How to get AI to write in your voice: every sentence AI writes is smooth, but people who know you can tell it isn't you.

muc.title: Good, but not you
muc.text: AI writes smooth sentences, but people who know you can tell it's not your voice.

muc.title: Give it three things you wrote
muc.text: Choose three things you wrote yourself, like a long message, a post or a letter, and paste them together.

muc.title: Ask AI to describe your style
muc.text: Ask AI to describe that style: long or short sentences, favorite words, how you address people.

muc.title: Paste the description every time
muc.text: Fix the description, save it, and paste it every time you ask AI to write. It will sound closer to you.

muc.title: Five lines about your style
muc.text: Paste three things you've written, ask a chatbot to sum up your style in five bullet points, then save them.

thu: Paste three things you've written, ask a chatbot to sum up your style in five bullet points, then save them.
